services.name: Dolphin Watch
services.desc: Our Famous Dolphin Watch and Eco-Cruise! Rates 10 A.M. Dolphin Watch Tour (Adults and Children): $16 All other Dolphin Watch Tour (Adults and Children): $18 Please Note: Children are defined as 12 and under Duration 1.5 Hour About Rated Best Dolphin Watch Cruises for South Padre Island! Cruise aboard either the Xcape or the Getaway for 1 1/2 hours and enjoy watching some of natures most fascinating animals. We will drag a net and bring aboard sea-life for you to see up close. Please keep in mind that customers will be responsible for any lost or stolen items. Our experienced crew will identify and explain the catches. All creatures are returned safely to the bay. What to Bring Camera

services.name: Summer Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: The Best Firework Seats in Town! Rates Person (All Ages): starting at $35 Tuesday and Friday nights Duration 2 Hours & 30 Minutes About Join us for the absolute best seat in town…on the water underneath the sparkling fireworks as the sky lights up with a brilliant display of pyrotechnics. Watch The fireworks as they burst over the reflecting Laguna Madre Bay. Our “Spectacular Fireworks Cruise” is in conjunction with the South Padre Island Visitors Center Fireworks on the Bay event. Our fleet of USCG certified vessels has plenty of seats available for you & the family! Please keep in mind that customers will be responsible for any lost or stolen items. A must see & do while on South Padre

services.name: Snorkeling Trip
services.desc: Come See our Bay in a Different Way! Rates Adults, Children and Observers: $40 Please Note: Children are defined as 12 and under Duration 3 Hours About Experience one of the largest estuary in the world first hand with a unique snorkeling experience. The Laguna Madre is a unique hypersaline lagoon. It is the only one in the nation and one of only a handful that exist worldwide. This makes its marine life unique to our area such as Yellow goat, balloon fish, garden eel, trumpet fish, wrasse, sargassum fish, grouper, porgies, herring, moon jellyfish, spadefish, sergeant major, minnows, piggy perch, sea bream, hermit crabs, butterfly rays, and many more. Bring the whole family! Provided
